citation: P.L. 115-123, Division B (Further Additional Supplemental Appropriations for Disaster Relief Requirements Act, 2018), Title III, 132 Stat. 72: 'For an additional amount for "Construction and Environmental Compliance and Restoration" for repairs at National Aeronautics and Space Administration facilities damaged by hurricanes during 2017, $81,300,000' -- designated an emergency requirement. Also S.Rept. 115-275 p.161.

P.L. 115-123, Division B, Title III, 132 Stat. 72: 'For an additional amount for "Research and Related Activities" ... to repair National Science Foundation radio observatory facilities damaged by hurricanes that occurred during 2017, $16,300,000' -- designated an emergency requirement. Also S.Rept. 115-275 p.161.

P.L. 116-136 (CARES Act), Division B (Emergency Appropriations for Coronavirus Health Response and Agency Operations), Title III, 134 Stat. 514: 'For an additional amount for "Research and Related Activities", $75,000,000 ... to prevent, prepare for, and respond to coronavirus' -- designated an emergency requirement.

P.L. 117-43, Division B (Disaster Relief Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2022), Title III, 135 Stat. 359: 'For an additional amount for "Construction and Environmental Compliance and Restoration" for repair at National Aeronautics and Space Administration facilities damaged by Hurricanes Zeta and Ida ..., $321,400,000'.

P.L. 117-43, Division B, Title III, 135 Stat. 359: 'For an additional amount for "Major Research Equipment and Facilities Construction" for necessary expenses related to the National Science Foundation Regional Class Research Vessel construction impacted by Hurricane Ida, $25,000,000'.

P.L. 117-328, Division N (Disaster Relief Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2023), Title III, 136 Stat. 5205-5206: two appropriations to "Construction and Environmental Compliance and Restoration", $189,400,000 + $367,000,000 = $556,400,000 (the report prints the sum).
P.L. 117-328, Division N, Title III, 136 Stat. 5206: two appropriations to "Research and Related Activities", $2,500,000 + $818,162,000 = $820,662,000 (the report prints the sum).
